summary.name: Colorpicker
summary.one_liner: Colorpicker is a minimal desktop color picker app for grabbing, editing, storing and tinting colors, with an online version also offered.
use_cases: Pick a color from any design software, browser or image on screen
Find the hex or RGB code of a color
Save and organize colors into palettes
Create tints and shades to complete a color palette
summary.what_it_does: Colorpicker lets you grab any color on your screen, including from design software, browsers or images, and shows the hex or RGB code in real time. Colors can be adjusted with three RGB sliders, with HSL, CMYK and others mentioned as planned. Its Colorsbook feature stores colors in multiple palettes, and clicking a saved color loads it back into the interface. A tinting tool offers three shade levels based on HSL, with custom shade layers mentioned as future work.
notable: Open source desktop app, also listed as open source on the awesome-mac list
Colorsbook palette storage with click-to-load colors
Tinting tool with three HSL-based shade levels
Online simplified version available in the browser
caveats: Colorsbook is described as planned for improvement in future updates
Only three RGB sliders now; HSL, CMYK and more are described as coming soon
Only three shade levels currently; custom shade layers are future work
